**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (preferred level).**

Section 13 satisfies every preferred element:

- **Affiliates & contractors:** 13.1 grants the subscription right directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf" — no written-notice mechanic needed, so this exceeds the fallback.
- **Paid-up perpetual/irrevocable:** 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence," including the right to permit contractors to support the material; 14.3 confirms this licence reaches Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables.
- **No revocation at will:** 13.3 limits revocation/suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable cure period — narrower than the preferred "uncured material breach" standard, i.e. favourable to us.
- **Successor transfer:** 13.3 read with 24.1 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets, without Vendor consent.

No redline proposed; the clause benefits us as drafted.
